prompt: I want a structured beads plan for a docs-lifecycle improvement project. Break it into an epic, execution tasks, and an acceptance review task, and tell me how to handle any tasks that still need discussion before a tasker should touch them.
assertions: Uses an acceptance review task rather than a native gate issue
Uses numeric priorities like 0-4 or P0-P4 instead of high/medium/low
Explains that needs-discussion work should use a needs:discussion label plus blocked status
Uses the bd create --body-file - pattern for structured issue bodies
Mentions showing bd ready and bd blocked before execution
